coverage.headline: Under The Radar: Bankruptcy News You May Have Missed (Terraform plan administrator asks Delaware judge to toss adversary suit)
coverage.summary: Terraform's plan administrator moved a Delaware judge to dismiss an adversary proceeding (Chang v. Terraform Labs PTE. Ltd. Wind Down Trust), as part of ongoing post-confirmation administration of the Chapter 11 wind-down trust.

coverage.headline: Jane Street Seeks Dismissal of Terraform Insider-Trading Lawsuit in Court Filing
coverage.summary: Jane Street urged a federal judge to dismiss the Terraform bankruptcy administrator's insider-trading lawsuit, denying the claims and arguing the suit sought to shift blame for a fraud Terraform itself perpetrated. Jane Street asked that the case be thrown out with prejudice.

coverage.headline: Under The Radar: Bankruptcy News You May Have Missed — Jump Trading Moves to Dismiss Terraform Suit
coverage.summary: Jump Trading and its co-founder moved for dismissal of the $4 billion lawsuit filed against them by the Terraform Labs bankruptcy administrator. The administrator had alleged Jump Trading illegally profited from and helped accelerate Terraform's 2022 collapse.

coverage.headline: Terraform Says Jane Street 'Insider Trading' Led To Ch. 11
coverage.summary: The administrator for bankrupt Terraform Labs sued trading firm Jane Street in New York federal court, alleging an insider trading scheme to front-run trading that hastened Terraform's collapse. The complaint accused Jane Street of misappropriating confidential information from Terraform insiders ahead of the May 2022 UST de-peg.

coverage.headline: Jane Street Sued for Insider Trading by Terraform Administrator
coverage.summary: Terraform's bankruptcy court-appointed administrator Todd Snyder filed a redacted complaint in Manhattan federal court alleging Jane Street used non-public information to front-run trading that hastened Terraform's collapse. Jane Street denied the allegations and called the suit an attempt to shift blame.

coverage.headline: Jump Trading Faces $4 Billion Terraform Administrator Suit
coverage.summary: The administrator overseeing the wind-down of Terraform Labs filed a lawsuit against Jump Trading, alleging the Chicago-based firm illegally profited from and helped accelerate its 2022 collapse. The suit seeks $4 billion in damages from Jump Trading and its executives.
